verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI personal-assistant agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis. The evidence shows only fixed first-party integrations (calendar, inbox, Slack, Todoist import) and nothing about connecting MCP servers or using their tools. Fixed built-in integrations are adjacent features, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
